notes: V2.2 INJECTOR, SIZED ON CHAMBER PRESSURE. 40 x 1.20 mm in a 12.7 mm plate (L/D 10.58, HEM regime, inside the Waxman/NASA validated band). Target 25 bar, chosen from the tank dP ceiling: this holds >=20% injector margin for 86% of the liquid phase. Sized on chamber_pressure because that objective never inverts the regression law -- across every candidate regression fit (a spanning 9x) the plate moves only 40-45 holes, against 14-7618 holes for an O/F objective. REGRESSION COEFFICIENTS REMAIN UNMEASURED; the preset here is still the HRAP placeholder (= HTPB Thiokol). Expect O/F anywhere in 2.6-13.7 until you fire. GRAIN WARNING: at the full 4.48 kg oxidiser load the likely-N2O regression fits (SP7) consume 92-93% of the available 10.3 mm web. Load ~3.0 kg for the first fire (71% web used, ~5.5 s) to get a and n without risking burn-through.
